{"consolidated_memory":"crypto/keys/rotation.py - Security: Signature Mismatch in Key Rotation (Two Separate Issues)

OCCURRENCE 1 [2026-02-05]
- File: crypto/keys/rotation.py
- Problem: Signature mismatch in key rotation
- Signal: Verification failure against previous key
- Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Condition: Appeared only on staging read replica
- Repro trigger: Rotate the signing key while requests are in flight
- Fix: Moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #3500 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-1
- Stack: Python
- Covering test: tests/crypto/test_rotation.py
- Result: Flaky test resolved from 44 failures per 100 runs to zero

OCCURRENCE 2 [2026-03-25]
- File: crypto/keys/rotation.py
- Problem: Signature mismatch in key rotation
- Signal: Verification failure against previous key
- Root cause: Race condition in lazy initialisation
- Condition: Appeared only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Repro trigger: Rotate the signing key while requests are in flight
- Fix: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #8382 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-2
- Stack: Python
- Covering test: tests/crypto/test_rotation.py
- Result: p99 latency reduced from 9.2 s to 363 ms"}
